verification.earlierFindings: The first pilot passed eight cases and exposed two harness assumptions: unnamed combobox targeting also matched Move target, and existing TextInput Escape first blurs before modal dismissal. Named command search and the second Escape respect existing behavior. The corrected pilot passed 10 native cases and one production workflow. Keyboard-only save/recovery and actual red brush pixels across swapped/same-side/hidden layouts passed. Broad acceptance passed 38 native and 95 production cases before visual review adjusted only the workspace name field, primary Apply treatment and scoped checkbox/footer styles. Final affected native/production and light/dark short-window visual checks validate those two source changes; old source bytes and all reports are retained.
